messages:
maya: FYI starting onboarding for hummingbird-7b-quant. goal: host + dedicated canaries this week. need checklist: evals, quant experiments, fallback map, rollout config.
kevin: +1. plan to run INT8 and INT4 perf/quality sweep. prioritize int8 for hosted (lower reg risk).
liam: I'll run baseline on p4d and a100 nodes today — measuring p50/p95 tokens/s and mem. will post raw numbers.
anita: prepping prompt-suite (conversational + code + summarization) and edge case set. uploading to s3://redwood-evals/hummingbird7b/
sofia: recommend these rollout stages: hosted 1% canary -> 10% -> 50% then promote. Dedicated: reserve pool, smoke tests then gradual traffic shift. private: manual ops signoff.
maya: Also need KV-cache regression test and streaming/stop-seq sanity. can't regress top-k accuracy vs raven-13b beyond 1.5% on our summary set.
kevin: I'll run quant-aware finetune comparators and an int8 vs fp16 perplexity run. will check kernel selection impact and offload patterns.
liam: quick note: on P4D int4 gives ~1.8x tokens/s vs int8 on same model, but CPU postproc becomes bottleneck. include CPU profiling.
anita: eval script snippet I used:
```
python eval/run_eval.py --model hummingbird-7b-quant --suite hummingbird_v1 --batch 8 --max-toks 1024 --save results/hummingbird_eval.json
```
sofia: rollout config draft (canary routing + fallback):
```
canary:
  percent: 1
  fallback: raven-13b
  latency_slo_ms: 250
  error_rate_threshold: 0.02
metrics:
  monitor: [p50_latency, p95_latency, error_rate, quality_regressions]
```
maya: tagging @eng-sre for oncall variable for private deploys.
eng-sre: (bot) noted — please include change-id and runbook link.
kevin: one more: add kernel/compilation tags in model metadata so runtime picks correct kernels. example: "prefer_fused_attention: true".
maya: OK team — action items:
- kevin: quant perf vs quality
- liam: perf baselines + CPU profiling
- anita: prompt set + eval run
- sofia: rollout yaml + canary playbook
I'll consolidate results in the onboarding doc and schedule a quick signoff call tomorrow 10:30am PT.
:thumbsup:
